product_summary: Erawat Pharma Limited (Erawat Group, Indore, MP; 12-C/FA Scheme No. 94, Ring Road, Indore 452016) is an empty hard capsule shell manufacturer. Real product lines per its own site (erawat.com, product.php, hpmc-capsule-shells.php): empty hard GELATIN capsules in sizes 000/00/0/1/2/3/4/5 and EL, and HPMC (vegetarian) capsule shells in the same sizes; variants: sticky-free, preservative-free, liquid-filling, TSE/BSE-free (EDQM-certified bovine gelatin), SLS-free, metallic, pearl & golden capsules; capsule printing and dimensional/QC testing services. Certifications listed on site: ISO, GMP, Kosher, Halal, Export House Cert, US-FDA DMF. No food, FMCG or botanical-extract products found on the site.
comment: HS mapping: the declared codes do not describe the actual product. Empty two-piece hard capsule shells of gelatin or HPMC are classified in HS 9602 00 (worked unhardened gelatin and articles thereof; also covers HPMC/vegetable capsule shells in practice) — this is the correct primary code and is entirely absent from the declaration. 1302 39 (mucilages and thickeners, other) is wrong: the company does not sell gums/mucilages; at best 1302 39 could loosely touch HPMC polymer, but the product sold is a finished capsule shell, not the polymer. 3923 90 (plastic articles for conveyance/packing) is not corroborated — no plastic packaging product line on the site. 8422 30 (machinery for filling/closing capsules) is a misread of the site text: the site states filling machines (Zanasi, GKF, PAM, Sejong, MG2) are the CUSTOMERS' machines on which the capsules are run, and that Erawat builds its own production machines in its in-house engineering division for captive use — no machinery sales line found. Industry claim 'Продукты питания и FMCG' is a misclassification: the company is a pharma-excipient/primary-packaging (capsule shell) manufacturer, i.e. pharma/healthcare supply, not food/FMCG. Product lines missing from the declaration: HPMC/vegetarian capsule shells, capsule printing, and the specialty capsule variants (TSE/BSE-free, SLS-free, liquid-filling, metallic). Trader signs: none — site describes own manufacturing plants, in-house engineering and R&D, so role = manufacturer. Per project rule 3, the HS mismatch is NOT a rejection ground: company is retained and the code is corrected to 9602 00 as the primary line. All product data above is from the company's own website (erawat.com) and is therefore 'заявлено, не подтверждено' — no customs line was available in this check to corroborate any specific shipment or code. Note: search backend was unavailable and registry/volume research is out of scope for this role, so no shipment, revenue or registry data is asserted here.
